fusions.name: Line Pin Shot
fusions.desc: Shoots a pin at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 7 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Drawn Until It Snaps
fusions.desc: Releases a taut line in a ring, which deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Every hit is a critical hit.

fusions.name: Long Sight
fusions.desc: For 15 seconds, your attacks and spells reach 1.4 times as far.

fusions.name: True to the Bob
fusions.desc: Once every 10 seconds, a strike that failed to crit is rolled a second time, and the second roll stands.
